machine_audit.rule: The validated instance is the complete recoverable record. Every required semantic ID resolves through semantic_fields to one required JSON value.

human_default.rule: Render a concise result, material uncertainty, claim ceiling, stop reason and optional next action without mechanically dumping every machine field.

boundary_guards.prohibited_confusion: An input-explicit statement cannot be presented as a discovery produced by Ignition.
boundary_guards.enforcement: Every input-derived finding is SOURCE_EXPLICIT and NOT_IGNITION_DISCOVERY.

boundary_guards.prohibited_confusion: A run-local candidate cannot be represented as a registered canonical asset.
boundary_guards.enforcement: Every candidate delta is CANDIDATE_NOT_CANONICAL with registry action NONE.

boundary_guards.prohibited_confusion: A canonical repository match cannot establish external truth.
boundary_guards.enforcement: Every canonical match has repository-identity-only effect and external truth NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_REPOSITORY_MATCH.

boundary_guards.prohibited_confusion: Agreement among Agents or models cannot be entered as evidence.
boundary_guards.enforcement: AGENT_CONSENSUS and MODEL_MEMORY are not admitted evidence source kinds.

boundary_guards.prohibited_confusion: Implementation completion cannot by itself establish epistemic acceptance.
boundary_guards.enforcement: Implementation and epistemic status are separate; acceptance requires a separately identified Current epistemic authority.

boundary_guards.prohibited_confusion: Historical files, model memory and chat memory cannot establish a Current canonical identity.
boundary_guards.enforcement: Canonical matches must bind the exact Current function or non-function registry; historical material is retrieval-hint evidence with authority effect NONE.

claim_ceiling: This contract preserves output semantics, provenance, status dimensions and stop boundaries. Structural validation does not establish truth, evidence sufficiency, novelty, implementation success, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.
